fileNodes.name: api.ts
fileNodes.summary: Loopback HTTP API server built on Bun.serve that exposes skill listing, search, installation, removal, update, preferences, and health-check routes. Enforces host/origin allowlists, bearer authentication, cross-site fetch rejection, token-bucket rate limiting, request body limits, and per-server list/description caching.

fileNodes.name: hosted-auth.ts
fileNodes.summary: Authentication and browser-boundary protection helpers for hosted WebUI access to the local API server. Provides stable bearer token persistence, constant-time bearer verification, DNS-rebinding Host checks, cross-site fetch detection, and CORS/preflight responses.

fileNodes.name: hooks.ts
fileNodes.summary: Manages user-configured external post-mutation hooks and health-check commands specified via SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK and SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD. Spawns executables in sanitized environments with timeouts, sanitizes output, and caches health-check results with in-flight deduplication.

fileNodes.name: install.ts
fileNodes.summary: Service wrapper around `skills add --yes --json` for installing one, several, or all (`*`) skills from a source into project or global scope. Parses CLI JSON output and sanitizes all returned metadata fields at ingress.

fileNodes.name: installed.ts
fileNodes.summary: Lists and looks up installed skills for project or global scope via `skills ls --json`. Enriches each skill with provenance classification (`linked`, `locked`, or `local`) using symlink inspection and lockfile membership while sanitizing display metadata.

fileNodes.name: locks.ts
fileNodes.summary: Read-only lockfile reader for project (`skills-lock.json`) and global XDG state (`.skill-lock.json` / `skills-lock.json`) lock files. Validates entries individually with per-entry diagnostics while raising InvalidLockFileError on container-level corruption.

fileNodes.name: remove.ts
fileNodes.summary: Service wrapper around `skills rm -y [-g]` that verifies removal accuracy by diffing before- and after-installed skill lists. Supports injectable `listBefore`/`listAfter` callbacks so the HTTP API can reuse and refresh its per-server cache.

fileNodes.name: sanitize.ts
fileNodes.summary: CWE-150 terminal-escape and control-character scrubbing utilities applied at ingress for all external strings from the skills CLI, lockfiles, SKILL.md documents, and registry API.

fileNodes.name: search.ts
fileNodes.summary: Registry search client for skills.sh with in-flight request deduplication, ingress sanitization, and fuzzy fallback strategies including hyphenated-prefix gating, trailing-dash character fan-out, and progressive query shortening.

fileNodes.name: skill-doc.ts
fileNodes.summary: Reads skill documentation (`SKILL.md`) from either a direct file path or skill directory, strips leading YAML frontmatter, and sanitizes the markdown body for safe rendering.

fileNodes.name: source.ts
fileNodes.summary: Discovers skills available in an external source by running `skills install <source> --list --yes` with `FORCE_COLOR=1` and parsing sanitized skill names from cyan ANSI spans.

fileNodes.name: types.ts
fileNodes.summary: Shared domain type and interface definitions for scopes, skill provenance, mutation events, hook/health-check payloads, installed/search skills, add results, and update-check reports.

fileNodes.name: update.ts
fileNodes.summary: Thin service wrapper around `skills update -p|-g -y [names]` that updates selected or all skills in a scope and sanitizes combined CLI output.

fileNodes.name: updates-check.ts
fileNodes.summary: Read-only update checker that compares locked GitHub skill folder SHAs against live repository trees fetched from the GitHub Trees API. Enforces strict tree completeness checks, null-prototype result maps, per-entry lock diagnostics, and inconclusive-status reporting for truncated or missing folders.

fileNodes.name: skills-client.ts
fileNodes.summary: Subprocess client for the external `skills` CLI executable with runtime binary resolution, allowlist/denylist environment sanitization, serialized spawn-queue execution, timeout enforcement, and version probing.

fileNodes.name: spawn-queue.ts
fileNodes.summary: Bounded FIFO async semaphore that serializes `skills` CLI child processes and rejects overflow requests immediately with SkillsBusyError to defend against request storms.

fileNodes.name: hosted-auth.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Unit and HTTP integration test suite verifying hosted-UI bearer token generation/persistence, Host and Origin allowlists, CORS preflight behavior, token-free `/api/version` probing, and cross-origin bearer enforcement.

fileNodes.name: locks.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Test suite covering per-entry lockfile validation and diagnostics, container-level InvalidLockFileError 400 mapping on `/api/updates`, `__proto__` prototype safety, and strict GitHub tree completeness/inconclusive-result handling.

fileNodes.name: sanitize.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Unit and end-to-end ingress sanitization tests confirming ANSI/C1 escape and control-character stripping across `stripEscapes`, `sanitizeMetadata`, `sanitizeBody`, CLI service wrappers (`ls`, `install --list`, `add`), and HTTP API responses.

fileNodes.name: serve-hardening.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Hostile-input security and resilience test suite verifying timing-safe bearer matching, FIFO spawn-queue overflow (503), GitHub tree URL encoding/completeness, cross-site fetch-metadata rejection, argv/shape boundary validation, 1 MiB body caps, rate limiting, and slow-handler idle timeouts.

fileNodes.name: disk-index.ts
fileNodes.summary: Persists per-scope stale-while-revalidate caches of enriched installed skills to ~/.cache/skills-ui using atomic tmp-plus-rename writes and strict input sanitization. Partitions project-scope caches by SHA-256 hash and canonical projectRoot realpath while keeping global caches shared across projects.

fileNodes.name: index.ts
fileNodes.summary: Core barrel module that re-exports skill filtering, CLI subprocess helpers, installed/search/mutation/update/lock services, post-mutation hooks, and health checkers for TUI and web consumers.

fileNodes.name: prefs.ts
fileNodes.summary: Manages persistent UI preferences (theme, sound, reduceMotion, port, listWidth) stored in ~/.config/skills-ui/prefs.json with schema normalization and one-time migration from the upstream skills CLI.

fileNodes.name: seed.ts
fileNodes.summary: Parses CLI command arguments (add, update, remove and aliases) into a structured UiSeed describing which tab, query, or skill selections the UI should pre-populate on launch.

fileNodes.name: theme.ts

fileNodes.name: Views.tsx

fileNodes.name: app.ts

fileNodes.name: art.ts

fileNodes.name: audio.ts

fileNodes.name: model.ts

fileNodes.name: renderer-ready.ts

fileNodes.name: three-scene.ts

fileNodes.name: core.ts

fileNodes.name: hooks-health.test.ts

fileNodes.name: selftest.test.ts

fileNodes.name: tui-disk-index.test.ts

fileNodes.name: tui.test.ts

fileNodes.summary: Real-terminal PTY smoke test suite driving src/main.ts via PtyApp and asserting frame integrity, global-scope transitions, END/HOME/PgDn cursor following, mouse clicks, live filtering, and registry search paging against a local HTTP fixture server.

fileNodes.name: verify-build-targets.ts
fileNodes.summary: Post-build verification script that inspects all four compiled binaries in dist/ with the file utility to confirm Mach-O/ELF target architectures and asserts every binary's SHA-256 digest matches checksums-<version>.txt.

fileNodes.name: filter.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines the shared installed-skill filter predicate (F1 filter parity, S-164) consumed by both the TUI model and the inlined WebUI client script. Enforces template-literal-safe syntax so its transpiled source can be interpolated verbatim into APP_JS.

fileNodes.name: spike.ts
fileNodes.summary: OpenTUI proof-of-concept and selftest screen module defining Catppuccin Mocha syntax tokens and a markdown-rendering panel backed by the tree-sitter worker. Used by --selftest and standalone spike launches to verify native markdown rendering in compiled binaries.

fileNodes.name: hosted.e2e.ts
fileNodes.summary: Playwright end-to-end test suite exercising the hosted GitHub Pages frontend and local serve WebUI against live skills-ui serve subprocesses backed by skills-shim.mjs. Verifies Local Network Access gating, token auth, honest error toasts, search in-flight ordering, keyboard/sort semantics, and XSS-safe markdown detail rendering.

fileNodes.name: SKILL.md
fileNodes.summary: Adversarial SKILL.md contract fixture embedding ANSI/OSC/DCS escape sequences and C1 control characters in frontmatter and body text to test terminal and HTML sanitization.

fileNodes.name: skills-shim.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Executable fixture shim emulating the upstream skills CLI subprocess contract (--version, ls --json, install --list, add --json, rm, update) with persistent state files, env-sanitization snapshots, optional failure injection, and JSONL call logging for performance budgets.

fileNodes.name: slow-skills-shim.mjs
fileNodes.summary: Delayed skills CLI shim that sleeps SKILLS_SHIM_DELAY_MS (default 150 ms) before answering ls requests so concurrency and subprocess spawn-queue tests can deterministically trigger queuing.

fileNodes.name: image.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Bun unit test verifying that OpenTUI ImageRenderable constructs and renders a PNG via the blocks protocol in-memory, and pinning the vendored Jimp-free @opentui/three fork's unsupported-operation throws for file-image APIs (S-228).

fileNodes.name: services.test.ts
fileNodes.summary: Unit and integration test suite for skills-ui core services, preferences, CLI seed parsing, WCAG theme tokens, and registry search fallback and in-flight deduplication. Exercises core modules dynamically against the tests/fixtures/skills-shim.mjs CLI shim and ephemeral loopback Bun HTTP registry stubs.
